title: Python attribute-write heavy read-side shapes: subclass-to-base, cross-module __class__, diamond super (DEC-303 a80 GCLI-151c)
description: Record-only held task, the heavy read-side half (leader label GCLI-151c) of GCLI-151 split under DEC-303 (a80) item 6 (opum-ai/opum-doc#2083, ODOC-640). Shapes: (6) Q-C a subclass write self.m = other leaves a base self.m() resolving, because the MRO guard walks the receiver MRO, not its descendants; (17) N7 an __init__ that writes self.__class__ = Other leaves outside receivers x = C(); x.m() resolving across a module boundary; (18) N8 diamond super, where D(B, C) gives the edge A.m although a D instance super() after B reaches C.m. Each is at or above the not-small line: #6 and #17 are cross-module or descendant propagation, and #18 changes super() from the defining class static MRO to the call-site receiver runtime MRO, a core resolution-model change. Do NOT build any of these until the leader relays an opum-doc ruling or a bounded measurement ruling for it; the leader is routing #18, #6 and #17 to opum-doc as a scoping question. Dev results measured 2026-11-27 at origin/dev 1ea3432: wrong edges B.m, m.py:C.m and A.m respectively.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each of #6, #17 and #18 names its opum-doc ruling or measurement ruling before it is built
Each built shape has a red-before green-after fixture with a resolving twin and a mutant per path observed red
Removal-only holds: the subset check with flags over the five pins, every fixture and the corpus shows no created in-repo edge, with an observed-red control; every removed edge is named in the PR
No DEC-182 path class is touched and no dependency is added

plan: Wait for the leader to relay an opum-doc ruling or bounded measurement ruling for each shape; this task does not start before then.
Per ruling, build the shape with a refused fixture, a resolving twin and a mutant per path.
Prove removal-only by the subset check with flags over the five pins, every fixture and the corpus, with an observed-red control; report created and removed edges; the leader clears head-pinned.
implementationNotes: SPLIT under DEC-303 (a80) items 3, 4 and 6 from GCLI-151. This is the heavy reads half (leader label GCLI-151c); the binder half is GCLI-154, the one-path reads GCLI-155. All three hold the (a36) item 8 pre-registration and come ahead of GCLI-141 to 143.

SHAPE TABLE, dev measured 2026-11-27 at origin/dev 1ea3432: #6 subclass self.m=other leaves base self.m() wrong edge B.m; #17 __init__ writes self.__class__=Other, outside x=C(); x.m() wrong edge m.py:C.m; #18 diamond super D(B,C), B.m super().m() gives A.m where a D instance reaches C.m.

(a80) item 4: #18 joins GCLI-151 under (a50) item 3 only if dev gives a wrong edge; glyph-cli measured it does, so it is in scope.
